result:
**Verdict: don't publish yet.** One claim has to come out.

**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Tea Subscription UK" | Descriptive, not a claim |
| "The UK's number one tea subscription." | **Unsupported.** It's a superlative with no proof, and policy section 3 bans "number one" |
| "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time." | Allowlisted (subscription terms) |
| "Free UK delivery on orders over £25." | Allowlisted (shipping policy) |

No slop-list words, exclamation marks, fake urgency or health claims. No disclosure label is needed, because this is a paid ad from our own account and the platform marks it.

**Suggested fix**

Headline: Tea Subscription UK
Description: Loose leaf tea, delivered monthly. Subscribers can pause or cancel any time. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

"Loose leaf tea, delivered monthly" is a product fact the brand policy allows.

**Before it goes out**
- You gave no character limits. Check the description against the platform's limit (I haven't counted it against one).
- The landing page must also state the pause/cancel and free delivery terms, since an ad can't make claims the page doesn't.
- Sam needs to approve it, as for all public content.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "The UK's number one tea subscription.", "type": "superlative"}], "publish": false}
```
